findings.evidence: Basic.lean:645 `span : ∀ v : V, ∃ (a b : ℝ) (u : V), g K.q u = 0 ∧ g (pTransverse g K) u = 0 ∧ v = a • pTransverse g K + b • K.q + u` is character-identical to ParityOdd.lean:206; the ParityOdd docstring itself says "This is the `span` field of `SpectatorAssumptions`".
findings.fix: Move `SpectatorSplitting` to Tensors/Basic.lean immediately before `SpectatorAssumptions` and make `SpectatorAssumptions extends SpectatorSplitting`, deleting the duplicated `span` field.
findings.issue: `SpectatorSplitting` restates the `span` field of `SpectatorAssumptions` (Tensors/Basic.lean:642-646) verbatim, including its docstring, splitting the spectator-hypothesis surface across two files.

findings.evidence: Their fields mention only `g`, `K.q`, `pTransverse g K`; nothing in them depends on `ParityOddAssumptions` or `IsProperLorentzCovariant`.
findings.fix: Move all three (with `SpectatorPlane.spectatorSplitting`, ParityOdd.lean:221) into the `SpectatorAssumptions` section of Tensors/Basic.lean, leaving only `ParityOddAssumptions` and its consequences in ParityOdd.lean.
findings.issue: `SpectatorPair` (169), `SpectatorPlane` (196) and `SpectatorPartners` (212) are hypotheses about `(g, p, q)` and the isometry group with no parity-odd content — the same class Basic's `SpectatorAssumptions` section is declared to own ("facts about `g`, `p`, `q` and the isometry group — not about the hadronic tensor", Basic.lean:640-641) — yet they live in the later, topic-specific file.

findings.evidence: ParityOdd.lean:143-159 cites only `reflect_isKinematicStabilizer`, `apply_p_eq_zero_of_spectator`, `Bilin.det_reflect`, `Bilin.reflect_apply_self`, `Bilin.reflect_apply_of_orthogonal`, all from Tensors/Basic.lean; its statement contains no parity-odd notion.
findings.issue: `exists_half_turn` is a pure kinematic-stabilizer lemma (composite of two reflections has determinant one and reverses both directions); it belongs next to `reflect_isKinematicStabilizer` and the `Bilin.det_reflect` this PR adds to Basic for it.

summary: The new module and its import are placed correctly, but several parity-free, kinematics-level declarations live in ParityOdd.lean instead of Tensors/Basic.lean, where the spectator/stabilizer API already lives; one of them duplicates an existing structure field verbatim.
